 44s ago 16.30 EST 73 min : Chelsea look much more like the team fans are used to seeing since those subs were made with Cuthbert getting a shot away which is deflected out for yet another corner. Balitmore this time sends it in but it is scrambled away. It comes back in and out for another corner.
 Share 3m ago 16.28 EST 71 min : Chelsea set up another move with Buurman trying to slot it into the box but it rebounds out for a corner. Cuthbert pops it in and Bronze has a header but it’s cleared.
 Share 4m ago 16.27 EST 70 min : Charlier has only just turned 16, that was a fact that made me feel so old when delivered from the commentator so I thought I’d relay it to all of you. That means she was born in 2010, wow. She doesn’t look inexperienced on the pitch though as she is straight into the action but her shot is wide.
 Share 5m ago 16.25 EST 68 min : PSG make their second change of the game with Feller off for Charlier.
 Share 7m ago 16.24 EST 67 min : Cuthbert delivers the ball, it’s a great one with it scrappy in the box but a foul is put in on Kiedrzynek which stops the chance.
 Share 7m ago 16.23 EST 66 min : Chelsea come again and again and again but the net has not bulged with a goal. This PSG defensive set has been really impressive, the latest giving Chelsea a corner.
 Share 9m ago 16.22 EST 65 min : A very slow build-up from Chelsea ends with a poor cross collected by Kiedrzynek. The hosts managed to put something together again but Baltimore skies it over the bar. It is like Chelsea just run out of steam as soon as they are in front of goal, everywhere else they have so much energy.
 Share 11m ago 16.20 EST 63 min : Le Guilly makes a diving tackle and she lands awkwardly, gripping her ribs but she is okay to continue as Chelsea set up another attack.
 Share 13m ago 16.18 EST 61 min : Just like the first half, this mid section is becoming scrappy. So it seems fitting that Chelsea are making a triple change with Kaptein, McCabe and Thomspon off for Cuthbert, Bronze and Hamano.
 Share 15m ago 16.16 EST 59 min : Samoura came streaming int o the box but Carpenter does well to hustle her off of it in the box to manage the situation. This game has all of the action but none of the goals to back it up.
 Share 17m ago 16.14 EST 57 min : Kanjinga looks to create something but Baltimore is there to stifle the chance.
 Share 18m ago 16.13 EST 55 min : Groenen is over the set piece but it’s headed clear by Beever-Jones. PSG are trying to keep up this momentum though as they push for an opener.
 Share 19m ago 16.11 EST 54 min : Kanjinga, my word. She makes a very good run, McCabe makes contact on the edge of the box but the PSG player continues and rifles off a great shot which Hampton saves but gives away a corner.
 Share 21m ago 16.10 EST 53 min : Bjorn and Feller’s battle has been the best thing to watch in this match so far and they have another encounter as the Chelsea captain manages to get the better of her opponent on this occasion to see Hampton clear the danger.
 Share 23m ago 16.08 EST 51 min : Just as Chelsea waste a chance, so do PSG. Le Guilly looks to cross it in but Hampton reads it well and collects.
 Share 24m ago 16.07 EST 50 min : The hosts continue their pressure with a well weighted pass from McCabe into the box but no one can get onto it. That is the only part the Blues are missing right now but they are just so predictable right now, the latest chance comign from Potter with a direct kick at the keeper.
 Share 25m ago 16.06 EST 49 min : Chelsea start the second half as they played the first with a lot of possession but Baltimore can’t convert two chances.
 Share 27m ago 16.04 EST 47 min : Walsh came out of the team huddle just before this second half began holding her shoulder. She does not look comfortable but she remains on pitch for now.
 Share 28m ago 16.03 EST Back underway
 Will there be a winner? All of the action to come.
 Share 36m ago 15.55 EST Manchester City won their match earlier today , have a read below to catch up:
 Quick Guide WCL roundup: City subs Hemp and Shaw see off Häcken
 Show Lauren Hemp and Khadija Shaw both scored off the bench to earn Manchester City a 2-0 Women’s Champions League victory over Häcken in Gothenburg.
 The first half ended goalless with City's best chances coming just before the break. Aoba Fujino was put through on goal but she hit her effort straight at Häcken keeper Jennifer Falk, who made saves from Grace Clinton and Rebecca Knaak to keep the hosts on terms at the interval.
 Hemp and Shaw were both introduced at half-time by Andrée Jeglertz, and the England winger opened the scoring after 55 minutes. It was a fortuitous breakthrough, with Emma Östlund's clearance ricocheting off Hemp's shin and into the net [pictured]. Mary Fowler appeared to have added a second soon after, but her strike was ruled out for offside against Yui Hasegawa.
 Soon after Hemp was denied her second goal when her shot hit the post, she turned creator by passing to an onrushing Shaw, who tucked home for City's second in the 77th minute. The visitors could have had a third, but Falk saved Fowler's stoppage-time penalty after a VAR intervention.
 Signe Bruun also made the difference off the bench on Wednesday, scoring two late goals as Real Madrid wore down 10-woman Internazionale to win 3-1. The Danish forward put Madrid ahead five minutes of time before adding a late penalty to secure all three points.
 Lineth Beerensteyn got the hosts off the mark in Madrid after 28 minutes, and Inter faced an uphill battle after Karolina Vilhjalmsdottir was sent off three minutes before the break. The visitors got an unexpected equaliser when Michela Cambiaghi headed in from a corner, and held on until Bruun's late double.
 City and Real Madrid are both unbeaten after five league phase games, winning two and drawing three matches each as they bid to finish in the top four and avoid the playoff round. Press Association and Guardian sport 
 Photograph: Declan Lloyd/Manchester City FC Was this helpful? Thank you for your feedback. Share 38m ago 15.52 EST In the other 8pm GMT kick-off Juventus are drawing 0-0 with OH Leuven.
 Share 43m ago 15.47 EST Half-time: Chelsea 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain
 Chelsea have had the lionshare of possession but they just have not been clinical in front of goal. PSG have in fact looked a little more dangerous with frontfoot ball but they too haven’t found the back of the net. Will we see a goal? All to come in the second 45.
 Share 45m ago 15.46 EST 45 + 1 min : There will be one minute added.
 Share 46m ago 15.45 EST 45 min : Oh my word. That is the closest we have come to the deadlock being broken. Baltimore has a shot which Kiedrzynek saves, Thompson follows up on the rebound but the keeper is hurt with the ball cleared. Kiedrzynek is okay to continue.
 View image in fullscreen Alyssa Thompson of Chelsea has a shot on goal from close range saved by Katarzyna Kiedrzynek of Paris Saint-Germain Feminines. Photograph: Daniel Weir/SPP/Shutterstock Share Updated at  16.11 EST 48m ago 15.43 EST 43 min : Chelsea keep the ball until Baltimore has a shot but the quick chance is well read by Kiedrzynek. This game is screaming for a goal but no effort has really tested either keeper so far.
 Share 50m ago 15.41 EST 41 min : Echegini does really well against Baltimore to maintain possession in the midfield but a few passes later Samoura gifts the ball away to Chelsea. Some disjointed performances from both teams so far.
 Share 52m ago 15.39 EST 39 min : How did Beever-Jones not score there? Carpenter put in a pinpoint cross but Beever-Jones doesn’t get a clean connection and Kiedrzynek can collect easily.
 Share 54m ago 15.37 EST 37 min : End-to-end action as Chelsea now asBeever-Jones has a chance but it’s out for a goal kick. There is a lot of chat on commentary about the 23-year-old’s lack of clinicism in front of goal and it is a surprise how much her form has dropped off. I believe she ahs scored just one goal this season.
 Share 1h ago 15.35 EST 35 min : The visitors have some momentum with them now as Feller put in a great run before passing to Carmona. The defender puts in a lovely pass but Kanjinga’s header is wide.
 Share 1h ago 15.34 EST 34 min : Groenen wins possession in the midfield and they find Kanjinga, she weaves around McCabe but her shot hits the side netting. McCabe is having trouble containing her so far.
